verses.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם חָלָ֥ה חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לָמ֑וּת וַיָּב֣וֹא אֵ֠לָיו יְשַׁעְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ אָמ֜וֹץ הַנָּבִ֗יא וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ צַ֣ו לְבֵיתֶ֔ךָ כִּ֛י מֵ֥ת אַתָּ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm ḥā·lāh ḥiz·qî·yā·hū lā·mūṯ way·yā·ḇō·w ’ê·lāw yə·ša‘·yā·hū ḇen- ’ā·mō·wṣ han·nā·ḇî way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣaw lə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā kî mêṯ ’at·tāh wə·lō ṯiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: In those days Hezekiah became mortally ill The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz came to him and said . . . This is what the LORD says Put your house in order for you are about to die you will not recover

verses.original: וַיַּסֵּ֧ב חִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ פָּנָ֖יו אֶל־ הַקִּ֑יר וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yas·sêḇ ḥiz·qî·yā·hū pā·nāw ’el- haq·qîr way·yiṯ·pal·lêl ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר אָנָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ זְכָר־ נָ֞א אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לְפָנֶ֗יךָ בֶּֽאֱמֶת֙ וּבְלֵ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם וְהַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּכִ֥י גָדֽוֹל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar ’ān·nāh Yah·weh zə·ḵār- nā ’êṯ ’ă·šer hiṯ·hal·laḵ·tî lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā be·’ĕ·meṯ ū·ḇə·lêḇ šā·lêm wə·haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ‘ā·śî·ṯî way·yê·ḇək ḥiz·qî·yā·hū bə·ḵî ḡā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: saying Please O LORD remember . . . how I have walked before You faithfully and with wholehearted devotion I have done what is good in Your sight And Hezekiah . . . wept bitterly

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־ יְשַׁעְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yə·ša‘·yā·hū lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the word of the LORD came to Isaiah saying

verses.original: הָל֞וֹךְ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֶל־ חִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔יךָ שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ אֶת־ תְּפִלָּתֶ֔ךָ רָאִ֖יתִי אֶת־ דִּמְעָתֶ֑ךָ הִנְנִי֙ יוֹסִ֣ף עַל־ יָמֶ֔יךָ חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·lō·wḵ wə·’ā·mar·tā ’el- ḥiz·qî·yā·hū kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā šā·ma‘·tî ’eṯ- tə·p̄il·lā·ṯe·ḵā rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- dim·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā hin·nî yō·w·sip̄ ‘al- yā·me·ḵā ḥă·mêš ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh
verses.literal: Go and tell . . . Hezekiah that this is what the LORD the God of your father David says I have heard your prayer I have seen your tears Behold I will add fifteen . . . years to your life

verses.original: וּמִכַּ֤ף מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁוּר֙ אַצִּ֣ילְךָ֔ וְאֵ֖ת הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את וְגַנּוֹתִ֖י עַל־ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mik·kap̄ me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr ’aṣ·ṣî·lə·ḵā wə·’êṯ hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ wə·ḡan·nō·w·ṯî ‘al- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria I will defend . . . this city

verses.original: וְזֶה־ לְּךָ֥ הָא֖וֹת מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh- lə·ḵā hā·’ō·wṯ mê·’êṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śeh Yah·weh ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ’ă·šer dib·bêr
verses.literal: This will be a sign to you from the LORD that He will do what . . . He has promised

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י מֵשִׁ֣יב אֶת־ צֵ֣ל הַֽמַּעֲל֡וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָרְדָה֩ בְמַעֲל֨וֹת אָחָ֥ז בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶשׁ אֲחֹרַנִּ֖ית עֶ֣שֶׂר מַעֲל֑וֹת וַתָּ֤שָׁב הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר מַעֲל֔וֹת בַּֽמַּעֲל֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָרָֽדָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hin·nî mê·šîḇ ’eṯ- ṣêl ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’ă·šer yā·rə·ḏāh ḇə·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’ā·ḥāz baš·še·meš ’ă·ḥō·ran·nîṯ ‘e·śer ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ wat·tā·šāḇ haš·še·meš ‘e·śer ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ bam·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’ă·šer yā·rā·ḏāh
verses.literal: I will make the sun’s shadow that falls on the stairway of Ahaz go back ten steps So the sunlight went back the ten . . . steps it had descended

verses.original: מִכְתָּ֖ב לְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֑ה בַּחֲלֹת֕וֹ וַיְחִ֖י מֵחָלְיֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: miḵ·tāḇ lə·ḥiz·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ba·ḥă·lō·ṯōw way·ḥî mê·ḥā·lə·yōw
verses.literal: This is a writing by Hezekiah king of Judah after his illness and recovery . . .

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י אָמַ֗רְתִּי בִּדְמִ֥י יָמַ֛י אֵלֵ֖כָה בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֣י שְׁא֑וֹל פֻּקַּ֖דְתִּי יֶ֥תֶר שְׁנוֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ’ā·mar·tî biḏ·mî yā·may ’ê·lê·ḵāh bə·ša·‘ă·rê šə·’ō·wl puq·qaḏ·tî ye·ṯer šə·nō·w·ṯāy
verses.literal: I said In the prime of my life I must go through the gates of Sheol and be deprived of the remainder of my years

verses.original: אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ לֹא־ אֶרְאֶ֣ה יָ֔הּ יָ֖הּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַחַיִּ֑ים לֹא־ אַבִּ֥יט אָדָ֛ם ע֖וֹד עִם־ י֥וֹשְׁבֵי חָֽדֶל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar·tî lō- ’er·’eh yāh yāh bə·’e·reṣ ha·ḥay·yîm lō- ’ab·bîṭ ’ā·ḏām ‘ō·wḏ ‘im- yō·wō·šə·ḇê ḥā·ḏel
verses.literal: I said I will never again see the LORD even the LORD in the land of the living I will no longer look on mankind with those who dwell in this world

verses.original: דּוֹרִ֗י נִסַּ֧ע וְנִגְלָ֛ה מִנִּ֖י כְּאֹ֣הֶל רֹעִ֑י קִפַּ֨דְתִּי כָאֹרֵ֤ג חַיַּי֙ מִדַּלָּ֣ה יְבַצְּעֵ֔נִי מִיּ֥וֹם עַד־ לַ֖יְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: dō·w·rî nis·sa‘ wə·niḡ·lāh min·nî kə·’ō·hel rō·‘î qip·paḏ·tî ḵā·’ō·rêḡ ḥay·yay mid·dal·lāh yə·ḇaṣ·ṣə·‘ê·nî mî·yō·wm ‘aḏ- lay·lāh taš·lî·mê·nî
verses.literal: My dwelling has been picked up and removed from me like a shepherd’s tent I have rolled up my life like a weaver He cuts me off from the loom from day until night You make an end of me

verses.original: שִׁוִּ֤יתִי עַד־ בֹּ֙קֶר֙ כָּֽאֲרִ֔י כֵּ֥ן יְשַׁבֵּ֖ר כָּל־ עַצְמוֹתָ֑י מִיּ֥וֹם עַד־ לַ֖יְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: šiw·wî·ṯî ‘aḏ- bō·qer kā·’ă·rî kên yə·šab·bêr kāl- ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯāy mî·yō·wm ‘aḏ- lay·lāh taš·lî·mê·nî
verses.literal: I composed myself until the morning Like a lion . . . He breaks all my bones from day until night You make an end of me

verses.original: כְּס֤וּס עָגוּר֙ כֵּ֣ן אֲצַפְצֵ֔ף אֶהְגֶּ֖ה כַּיּוֹנָ֑ה דַּלּ֤וּ עֵינַי֙ לַמָּר֔וֹם אֲדֹנָ֖י עָֽשְׁקָה־ לִּ֥י עָרְבֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kə·sūs ‘ā·ḡūr kên ’ă·ṣap̄·ṣêp̄ ’eh·geh kay·yō·w·nāh dal·lū ‘ê·nay lam·mā·rō·wm ’ă·ḏō·nāy ‘ā·šə·qāh- lî ‘ā·rə·ḇê·nî
verses.literal: I chirp like a swallow or crane . . . I moan like a dove My eyes grow weak as I look upward O Lord I am oppressed be my security

verses.original: מָֽה־ אֲדַבֵּ֥ר וְאָֽמַר־ לִ֖י וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑ה אֶדַּדֶּ֥ה כָל־ שְׁנוֹתַ֖י עַל־ מַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: māh- ’ă·ḏab·bêr wə·’ā·mar- lî wə·hū ‘ā·śāh ’ed·dad·deh ḵāl šə·nō·w·ṯay ‘al- mar nap̄·šî
verses.literal: What can I say He has spoken to me and He Himself has done this I will walk slowly all my years because of the anguish of my soul

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֖י עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יִֽחְי֑וּ וּלְכָל־ בָּהֶן֙ חַיֵּ֣י רוּחִ֔י וְתַחֲלִימֵ֖נִי וְהַחֲיֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy ‘ă·lê·hem yiḥ·yū ū·lə·ḵāl- bā·hen ḥay·yê rū·ḥî wə·ṯa·ḥă·lî·mê·nî wə·ha·ḥă·yê·nî
verses.literal: O Lord by such things men live and in all of them my spirit finds life You have restored me to health and have let me live

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה לְשָׁל֖וֹם מַר־ לִ֣י מָ֑ר וְאַתָּ֞ה חָשַׁ֤קְתָּ נַפְשִׁי֙ מִשַּׁ֣חַת בְּלִ֔י כִּ֥י הִשְׁלַ֛כְתָּ אַחֲרֵ֥י גֵוְךָ֖ כָּל־ חֲטָאָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh lə·šā·lō·wm mar- lî mār wə·’at·tāh ḥā·šaq·tā nap̄·šî miš·ša·ḥaṯ bə·lî kî hiš·laḵ·tā ’a·ḥă·rê ḡê·wə·ḵā kāl- ḥă·ṭā·’āy
verses.literal: Surely for my own welfare I had such great anguish but Your love has delivered me from the pit of oblivion for You have cast all my sins behind Your back

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֥א שְׁא֛וֹל תּוֹדֶ֖ךָּ מָ֣וֶת יְהַלְלֶ֑ךָּ לֹֽא־ יְשַׂבְּר֥וּ יֽוֹרְדֵי־ ב֖וֹר אֶל־ אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō šə·’ō·wl tō·w·ḏe·kā mā·weṯ yə·hal·le·kā lō- yə·śab·bə·rū yō·wr·ḏê- ḇō·wr ’el- ’ă·mit·te·ḵā
verses.literal: For Sheol cannot thank You Death cannot praise You Those who descend to the Pit cannot hope for Your faithfulness

verses.original: חַ֥י חַ֛י ה֥וּא יוֹדֶ֖ךָ כָּמ֣וֹנִי הַיּ֑וֹם אָ֣ב לְבָנִ֔ים יוֹדִ֖יעַ אֶל־ אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥay ḥay hū yō·w·ḏe·ḵā kā·mō·w·nî hay·yō·wm ’āḇ lə·ḇā·nîm yō·w·ḏî·a‘ ’el- ’ă·mit·te·ḵā
verses.literal: The living only the living . . . can thank You as I do today . . . fathers will tell their children about Your faithfulness

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי וּנְגִנוֹתַ֧י נְנַגֵּ֛ן כָּל־ יְמֵ֥י חַיֵּ֖ינוּ עַל־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh lə·hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî ū·nə·ḡi·nō·w·ṯay nə·nag·gên kāl- yə·mê ḥay·yê·nū ‘al- bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The LORD will save me we will play songs on stringed instruments all the days of our lives in the house of the LORD

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְשַׁעְיָ֔הוּ יִשְׂא֖וּ דְּבֶ֣לֶת תְּאֵנִ֑ים וְיִמְרְח֥וּ עַֽל־ הַשְּׁחִ֖ין וְיֶֽחִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·ša‘·yā·hū yiś·’ū də·ḇe·leṯ tə·’ê·nîm wə·yim·rə·ḥū ‘al- haš·šə·ḥîn wə·ye·ḥî
verses.literal: Now Isaiah had said Prepare a lump of pressed figs and apply it to the boil and he will recover

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ מָ֣ה א֑וֹת כִּ֥י אֶעֱלֶ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥiz·qî·yā·hū māh ’ō·wṯ kî ’e·‘ĕ·leh bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: And Hezekiah had asked What will be the sign that I will go up to the house of the LORD
